brand_ambassador_title: Luis Suárez — Official Brand Ambassador of the {{supportName}} Alliance
intro_text_1: Luis Suárez isn't just a football legend — he's the embodiment of raw determination and unshakable tenacity.
intro_text_2: A champion who built his name by challenging the odds and rewriting the rules, Suárez now brings that same fire to the {{supportName}} Alliance as our official brand ambassador.
unstoppable_text_1: Known across the globe for his explosive drive and unwavering pursuit of excellence, Luis Suárez perfectly mirrors the spirit of {{supportName}} — a network fueled by ambition, performance, and the belief that limits are meant to be broken.
unstoppable_text_2: Together, we’re not just raising the bar. We’re challenging everything — in sport, in entertainment, and in the way the world plays.
afa_title: Argentine Football Association - Regional Partner of the {{supportName}} Alliance
afa_intro_1: This is more than a sponsorship — it's a statement.
afa_intro_2: {{supportName}} is proud to be a regional partner of the Argentine Football Association — the reigning kings of world football and a symbol of relentless passion, technical brilliance, and championship DNA.
champions_title: Be the First. Champions Don’t Follow.
champions_text_1: From Maradona to Messi, the AFA has always set the pace, defied expectations, and inspired the world.
champions_text_2: At {{supportName}}, we recognize that spirit — the fearless hunger to dominate, the refusal to settle, and the drive to keep pushing even when you're already on top.
champions_text_3: This partnership brings that same championship mentality into everything we do — from digital entertainment to immersive player experiences.
villarreal_title: Villarreal CF — Official Betting Partner of the {{supportName}} Alliance
villarreal_intro_1: {{supportName}} is proud to team up with Villarreal CF as an official partner — aligning with one of Spain’s most respected clubs, known for heart, discipline, and fearless ambition.
villarreal_intro_2: From local roots to European triumphs, Villarreal embodies the power of belief and strategy — a spirit that mirrors {{supportName}}’s own journey across digital entertainment and beyond.
villarreal_intro_3: Together, we’re turning ambition into action, and passion into unforgettable experiences.
more_than_game_text_1: This collaboration celebrates everything we stand for:High performance. Intelligent play. Total commitment.
more_than_game_text_2: Together, we’re creating new ways for fans to feel the thrill, live the moment, and stay connected to the action — on and off the field.
